KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   D. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.

2. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. watoto
   B. mitoto
   C. kitoto
   D. mato

3. When practising nyakati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” nyakati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding nyakati.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to nyakati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for nyakati.

4. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.

5. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.

6. When practising upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   B. Copy random text without understanding upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   D. Use insults to “practise” upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.

7. When practising Usalama, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Usalama.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Usalama.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Usalama.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Usalama.

8. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.

9. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. pana
   B. nene
   C. fupi
   D. zito

10. When practising Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Maagano.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maagano.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Maagano.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Maagano.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Sokoni and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
